# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 12 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Honeycomb Burns; Aseneth Sees a Vision of the Eighth Heaven

---

**12:1** The man of God stretched out his right hand and traced on the honeycomb with his finger from east to west. The path of his finger became fire and burned up the comb. Yet no smoke arose from the burning.

**12:2** Aseneth was astonished at the sight and trembled with great fear.

**12:3** The man of God said to Aseneth: 'Did you see this?' She said: 'Yes, lord, I saw it all.'

**12:4** The man said to her: 'So too shall be the words of my mouth: sweet as honey, yet burning as fire, consuming the enemies of the righteous.'

**12:5** Aseneth said to the man: 'Lord, I have seven virgin companions who were raised with me from childhood. May I call them to you, so that you may bless them as you have blessed me?'

**12:6** The man said: 'Call them.' Aseneth called the seven virgins, and the man blessed them and said: 'The Lord God Most High will bless you, and you shall be like the seven pillars of the City of Refuge, and all the chosen ones of that city will rest upon you forever.'

**12:7** The man said to Aseneth: 'Take away the table.' When Aseneth turned to remove it, the man of God was immediately taken up to the heavens in a fiery chariot.

**12:8** Aseneth said: 'How foolish and presumptuous I was, to speak so boldly before the man of God. For I did not know that he was a son of God, yet he told me that my name is written in the Book of the Living in heaven.'

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
